name: Garlic Bread
steps: Mix the 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup plain yogurt, 4 tablespoons olive oil, and 1/2 teaspoon salt into a soft dough; knead 3 minutes and rest 15.
Divide into 6 balls and roll each thin.
Cook in a hot dry skillet 2 minutes per side until puffed and spotted.
Wrap in a clean towel and serve warm.
